description: Retrospective. A program is named days in a rotation order, not weekday-pinned. Exercises are a shared library reused across days; a session holds logged sets. No session-exercise join table: an exercise belongs to a session iff it has at least one logged set, which keeps sessions immutable records and programs reusable templates. Day names are snapshot onto the session so renaming or deleting a day cannot rewrite history.
title: Model programs, days, and logged sets
